name: application-charts
title: Charts
description: Chart components for visualizing trends, comparisons, and breakdowns in dashboards and analytics pages, built with Chart.js.
useWhen: Chart components for visualizing trends, comparisons, and breakdowns in dashboards and analytics pages, built with Chart.js.
avoidWhen: Avoid charts when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Charts uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
